description: This file defines the BlockTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing 'block' tags in templates, enabling reusable sections within templates.

classes.name: BlockTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing block tags in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'block' tag in a Twig template, creating a BlockNode and managing parsing scope.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Callback to determine if the current token marks the end of a block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this tag, which is 'block'.
